_comment: The acceptance contract for the ACTIVE spec. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Enforced by scripts/hooks/guard-protected.sh. Written from brain/10-specs/f3-turn-context.md on 2026-09-19.

features.description: On a session turn with time frozen to a known instant, the system message sent to the model contains that ISO date and its weekday name.
Two prompt builds in the same session, time frozen to day 1 then day 2, show day 1 then day 2.
After a turn, no stored session message contains the frozen date: the context block is never persisted.
A session whose agent has no instructions and no memory still sends a system message carrying the context.
The time zone is the user's own when set, otherwise the system time zone; its name appears in the block and the local time shown is correct for it.
The block contains the invoking user's full name and none of 'frappe', 'flow', 'erpnext' (case-insensitive).
Upstream's existing test suite stays green unmodified, including TestAgentConfirmation.
